summary.text: Wendy McNamara is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 76, which she has represented since November 2010, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former high school teacher and assistant principal, she faces Democrat Logan Patberg in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Wendy McNamara was born and raised in Indiana and received an undergraduate degree in political science from the University of Indianapolis, a teacher certification from Valparaiso University, and a master's degree in education and educational leadership from the University of Southern Indiana.
She served as a teacher and department chair at Benjamin Bosse High School and Harrison High School, as supervisor of social studies and as an assistant principal at North High School.
She also served as an adjunct professor of world history at the University of Southern Indiana and taught political science and social studies methods at the University of Evansville.
McNamara took office in the Indiana House on November 3, 2010.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Courts and Criminal Code Committee and as a member of the Roads and Transportation Committee.
